Additional text “RM0.00”, “RM0.0” , or “RM0” is adding by operators in the beginning of the SMS content.

This is done to inform end users that they were not charged to receive these messages.

If you have not added this to your message body, the operator will automatically add it and this may compromise the maximum length of your SMS.

This signature must be taken into consideration when sending a message. Since in this case the operator may charge a fee for sending a concatenated message.

Customers sending promotional messages need to make sure that the mobile numbers are registered in this database (IYS). This permission database is managed by an organization assigned by the Ministry of Trade of Turkey.

We need an IYS database code along with a sender ID to register a promotional sender ID.

Please note that non-compliance to this regulation may attract penalty and the same will be passed to you.

More information can be found at the link https://iys.org.tr/iys/sss.
